name: Walker
bio: The name 'Walker' covers more than one man in these items. Messrs. Allan and Walker, tourists from Warren, Pa., visited the Bad Lands at the end of August 1885, and a witness named Walker testified in the de Mores trial in September 1885 that Luffsey and O'Donald had threatened to shoot de Mores.

moments.label: Witness Walker testified in the de Mores trial

mentions: Messrs. Allan and Walker, tourists from Warren, Pa., were visitors here Monday and Tuesday. They were much pleased with the country and will repeat their visit.
THE LATEST. From Bismarck.--The Prosecution have rested. Sensational scene in Court.--Attorney Long to the Fore.

…Luffsey was killed by the party, of which DeMores was a member.  This morning, witnesses McClung, Harmon and Walker testified that they heard Luffsey and O'Donald say the day before the shooting that they would shoot DeMores on sight. To-day's testimony is to the effect that they bore…
